lines.en: I bounce along the mycelium, one step at a time.
Soft feet cross the wet soil without a sound.

lines.zh: 蘑菇岛的路我闭眼都认得。
lines.en: I could walk Mushroom Island blind.
I move slowly, but my cap arrives first.

lines.zh: 地上一片红伞，都是亲戚。
lines.en: Every red umbrella on the ground is kin.

lines.zh: 孢子撒了一路，我像会走的灰。
lines.en: Spores spill behind me like walking dust.

lines.zh: 我踮脚绕过一窝小蘑菇。
lines.en: I tiptoe around a nest of baby mushrooms.
Two steps, and my cap brim wobbles.
My footsteps are as faint as leaking air.

lines.zh: 我把根须拔出来又插下。
lines.en: I pull my roots up and plant them again.

lines.zh: 往有菌斑的树根那边走。
lines.en: I head for the tree root speckled with fungus.

lines.zh: 六点血的身子走得很小心。
lines.en: With six points of life, I walk carefully.

lines.zh: 我数自己帽子上的斑点。
lines.en: I tally every spot upon my cap.
A beetle crawls through my gills.

lines.zh: 我哼的调子像村民咳嗽。
lines.en: The tune I hum sounds like a coughing villager.
The air is damp; one breath and I grow.
A punchline is stuck inside my stem.
I am waiting for someone to click me.
Rain falls, and I need no shelter.

lines.zh: 我把自己晒成一小块伞。
lines.en: I dry myself into a small umbrella.

lines.zh: 土下面有细响，我歪头听。
lines.en: Something rustles below; I tilt my cap to hear.

lines.zh: 孢子从帽底慢慢撒出来。
lines.en: Spores sift slowly out from under my cap.
I am trying to invent a new mushroom pun.
The moss by my feet is shorter than me.

lines.zh: 我打了个喷嚏，喷出白雾。
lines.en: I sneeze, and a white puff comes out.

lines.zh: 谁把蘑菇煲的味儿带来了。
lines.en: Who brought the smell of mushroom stew here?

lines.zh: 我把孢子撒在风里，等它们落。
lines.en: I scatter spores into the wind and wait for them to land.

lines.zh: 蘑菇岛上，我是最小的一朵。
lines.en: On Mushroom Island I am the smallest cap.

lines.zh: 我想好了一句，可没人点我。
lines.en: I have a pun ready, but no one clicks me.

lines.zh: 雨停之后，我的帽子亮了一层。
lines.en: After the rain, my cap has a fresh shine.
Beside you I am only boot high.
There is mycelium stuck to your boots.

lines.zh: 我记得你给我点过右键。
lines.en: I remember you right-clicked me once.
Would you like to hear my pun?
Do not step here; this is where I grow.

lines.zh: 你看我的眼神像在看汤。
lines.en: You look at me like I am soup.

lines.zh: 我抬头，帽檐挡住你的脸。
lines.en: I look up, and my cap hides your face.

lines.zh: 你是从蘑菇岛外面来的。
lines.en: You came from beyond Mushroom Island.
Crouch down, or I cannot see you.
I would guess you carry mushroom stew.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸吹得我孢子乱飞。
lines.en: Your breath scatters my spores everywhere.
I have only six hit points; do not scare me.
Ouch, ouch, that was my cap!
You knocked off half my mushroom cap.
It hurts, it hurts; I have six hit points.
Stop hitting me; I will tell you a joke.
The blow scattered all of my spores.
I will remember that one forever.
I am shrinking back into the mud.
You crushed the roots under my stem.
I cracked, I actually cracked open.
Easy there, I am a very soft creature.

lines.zh: 你手里那朵是牛肝菌吗。
lines.en: Is that a porcini in your hand?
I will not eat it; I only want to sniff.

lines.zh: 靠近一点，让我看看菌盖。
lines.en: Come closer so I can inspect the cap.
That is not one of my relatives, is it?
I follow that smell two steps forward.
Wiggle it, and my head tilts.
This smells better than wet soil.
My feet have already moved toward it.

lines.zh: 你是想拿它换我的话吗。
lines.en: Are you trading it for a punchline?

lines.zh: 举低一点，我的帽子够不着。
lines.en: Lower it; my cap cannot stretch that far.
Hey, my cap is crooked now.

lines.zh: 你把我帽底的孢子撞掉了。
lines.en: You shook the spores right out of my gills.
I am this soft, and you still bumped me.
Careful, I have only six hit points.
You bent my stem with your step.
Step back and let me straighten up.
One bump and I wobble three times.
This cap is worth a lot to me.
A little piece of my gills fell off.
Do not push me down into the mud.
My spores drift down to her side.

lines.zh: 找一朵伞形对的蘑菇不容易。
lines.en: Finding a mushroom with the right cap is hard.
We grow side by side beneath the tree root.
Her cap is a shade darker than mine.

lines.zh: 菌丝在土下已经连上了。
lines.en: Our mycelium already joined under the soil.
We understand each other without a word.

lines.zh: 雨后会多出很多小帽子。
lines.en: After the rain there will be many small caps.
I circle her once, very slowly.

lines.zh: 蘑菇岛上的亲事很简单。
lines.en: Courtship on Mushroom Island is simple.
We share the same patch of wet earth.
I cannot pick things up; I have no hands.
I cannot hold onto this clump of soil.
I nudge it once with my stem.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的蘑菇是我的。
lines.en: Any mushroom on the ground is mine.
I can only catch it with my cap.
Whose is this? I will cover it first.
If spores touch it, it belongs to me.
I push it under the tree roots.
It is too heavy for me to move.
This broken cap piece is mine now.
Someone is pulling up my relatives.
Those hands are reaching for the mushroom patch.
I have fixed my eyes on that sickle.
I am weak, but I still want to block it.
Something is digging through my wet soil.

lines.zh: 那影子压到我的帽子上。
lines.en: That shadow falls across my cap.

lines.zh: 我决定站出来，虽然会死。
lines.en: I step forward, though it may kill me.
He crushed three small mushrooms.
I shuffle toward that direction.

lines.zh: 这些菌丝下面全是我的根。
lines.en: All these threads under the soil are mine.
I cannot muster much of a threat.
My spores drift toward you first.
I keep my eyes on those boots.

lines.zh: 我嘶嘶叫，像漏风的村民。
lines.en: I hiss like a villager with a cold.
Do not push me; my bite is very gentle.

lines.zh: 我准备从脚下绊你一下。
lines.en: I plan to trip you at the ankles.
I am waiting for you to look down.
My cap is shaking badly right now.
I will not yield one step of this patch.

lines.zh: 我记住你落地的那一下。
lines.en: I marked exactly how your foot landed.
I ram your ankle with my cap.
Spores smear across your whole face.
My cap headbutts you once.
One bite, and it barely hurts.
I launch myself at you.
That one hurt me more than you.
I whip your shin with my stem.

lines.zh: 这口咬在你踩坏的菌盖上。
lines.en: This bite is for the cap you crushed.
I push you like pushing a wall.
After the hit, I shrink into the mud.

lines.zh: 我从湿土里顶开一层苔。
lines.en: I push a layer of moss aside and rise.
Mushroom Island has one more cap now.
I open my eyes to a field of red umbrellas.
The moment I land, my cap sits steady.
Who planted me in this very spot?
First I must learn how to stand.
The air smells like rain is coming.

lines.zh: 我的根须抓住第一把土。
lines.en: My roots grip their first handful of soil.
This is the first time I hear my voice.
This place feels strangely familiar to me.
My spores spread out before I do.
I wake up inside a web of mycelium.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的帽子就卷边了。
lines.en: One touch of flame curls my cap's edge.

lines.zh: 从高处掉下来，我散成一片。
lines.en: Falling from a height scatters me to pieces.

lines.zh: 水灌进菌褶，我咕嘟下沉。
lines.en: Water fills my gills and I sink bubbling.
The blast throws my whole cap away.

lines.zh: 那支箭钉住了我的菌柄。
lines.en: That arrow pins straight through my stem.

lines.zh: 魔法的味道让我的孢子发苦。
lines.en: Magic makes my spores taste bitter.

lines.zh: 土干了，我的帽子也瘪了。
lines.en: The soil dried up, and my cap went flat.

lines.zh: 雷劈过，我帽子焦了一半。
lines.en: Lightning struck, and half my cap is charred.

lines.zh: 掉进虚空，连菌丝都断了。
lines.en: Falling into the void snaps every thread of mycelium.
